notes.title: Hooray!
notes.content:
It's a few days late, but here's our release announcement post! 

We're so happy Locomotion is out and playable and everyone seems to be digging it. We've opened up a general discussion forum thread if y'all have any questions for the developers, or any feedback for us! 

This is where we'll be posting any future updates, so keep an eye out! 

Happy prospecting!
